message: 理事長の居場所

name: Helena
message: 「Oh, Synn-chan. What's the matter?」

name: Synn
message: 「No, um... I just thought it was unusual to see you out on the sports ground, Helena-san.」

name: Helena
message: 「I'm the chairwoman, you know? Anywhere on the grounds of Ryuusei Academy is practically my own backyard.」

name: Helena
message: 「No, not just that. I also need to know everything about Ryuusei Town, where my precious students live.」

name: Helena
message: 「This entire town is my territory.」

name: Helena
message: 「Everywhere, yet nowhere at all. Such is the successor to the Kujou headship...」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I don't quite follow...?」

name: Helena
message: 「What I mean is--oh! Club advisor spotted!」
Helena-san runs across the tennis club's courts.
She approaches the club advisor from behind.
After startling them by covering their eyes with a 'Guess who~?', she pulls some documents from her pocket and exchanges a few brief words.
Helena-san gets the teacher's signature-hold on? Isn't that document the KiraFes proposal?

name: Helena
message: 「Le-et's see, how far did we get? Oh right, we were talking about Ria's boobs, weren't we.」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No, we weren't!」

name: Helena
message: 「Heehee... You're turning all red.」

name: Helena
message: 「Still, you're a boy, Synn-chan, so you need to be properly informed.」

name: Helena
message: 「No matter how big Ria's boobs are, she's still just a kid. When the time comes, treat her gently like she's fragile, okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「Wh-Wh-Wh-Wh-What do you mean 'when the time comes'... L-L-L-L-Like I said, it's not like that!」

name: Synn
message: 「I know you're helping us out with KiraFes, Helena-san, but making you run around getting approval signatures and stamps feels like--」

name: Helena
message: 「You feel bad, like you're using me as an errand girl?」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yes...」

name: Helena
message: 「It's true that at this academy, even for a single small purchase, you have to explain the purpose to the teachers in charge and get their agreement.」

name: Helena
message: 「This system has been in place for decades, and it works well. You can't just dismiss it outright.」

name: Helena
message: 「Even as chairwoman, I shouldn't force through exceptions with heavy-handed authority. Proper channels have to be respected.」

name: Synn
message: 「Even so...」

name: Helena
message: 「Ufufu. Synn-chan, I used to be the Student Council president too, you know.」

name: Helena
message: 「I did all sorts of things with all sorts of friends... and right before my term ended, I finally realized something.」

name: Helena
message: 「In every era, there are kids like you who work hard aiming for something sparkly, and there are kids who act jaded and do nothing.」

name: Helena
message: 「However, the vast majority of students aren't either of those.」

name: Helena
message: 「They want to do something, they just don't know what to do or how to do it...」

name: Helena
message: 「Geez, you're only looking at me, Synn-chan. Not paying attention to those kids makes the Chairwoman sad, you know!」

name: Helena
message: 「Wait, whoa there, Track Club coach spotted!」

name: Synn
message: 「Got it. I'll run in the opposite direction and keep running around for KiraFes!」

name: Synn
message: 「Once I graduate and become an alumnus, please run with me then!」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my, hitting on me without even realizing it. Just as expected of the boy Ria entrusted the Rosary to.」

name: Helena
message: 「As a reward... ta-da! Let me present you with a kashiwa mochi.」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Um... stuffing my face with red bean paste while running all over the place is going to be pretty rough...」

name: Helena
message: 「I understand... ta-da! Kashiwa mochi x2.」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Hey, Helena-san!?」

name: Helena
message: 「Come now, if you don't accept them obediently, they'll keep doubling.」

name: Helena
message: 「Ta-da! Kashiwa mochi x4.」

name: Helena
message: 「Ryuusei Town will be buried in kashiwa mochi in no time! Eek, how terrifying!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ugh...! Nom, nom!」

name: Synn
message: 「Dank yoo for da food!!」

name: Helena
message: 「Hehe... I see. You're the Student Council president right now, aren't you, Synn-chan.」
